title: Lead delivery
invariant: no dead letters or overdue failures; disabled only while no receiver is configured

probes.name: dead-letters
probes.sql: SELECT id, attempts, left(last_error, 120) AS error FROM integration_outbox WHERE status::text = 'dead_letter'

probes.name: overdue-failed
probes.message: failed lead events overdue for retry by more than 1h (scheduler not running?)
probes.sql: SELECT id, attempts, next_attempt_at FROM integration_outbox WHERE status = 'failed' AND next_attempt_at < now() - interval '1 hour'

probes.name: undelivered-disabled
probes.message: lead events not delivered because no receiver is configured (DEC-0001)
probes.sql: SELECT count(*) AS events FROM integration_outbox WHERE status = 'disabled' HAVING count(*) > 0
